title: Split Text Box by Paragraphs (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Split Text Box by Paragraphs applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Split Text Box by Paragraphs (BtnSplitByParagraphs) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Merging text boxes follows top-to-bottom, left-to-right reading order with the documented 5 pt row tolerance
scenarios.expected: oPenEfficiency.Core.Tests drives ParagraphFlowPlanner for Split Text Box by Paragraphs (Merge Selected Text Boxes): shapes whose top edges differ by at most 5 pt count as one row and order left to right, beyond that tolerance the top edge decides, a later row sorts after an earlier one regardless of the left edge, and identical positions compare equal.

scenarios.title: Splitting drops empty paragraphs by default, keeps them on request, and merges with one paragraph mark per paragraph
scenarios.expected: oPenEfficiency.Core.Tests drives ParagraphFlowPlanner for Split Text Box by Paragraphs: a paragraph's trailing paragraph marks are stripped for the new text box, an empty paragraph is dropped by default and retained on the keep-empty route, and merging joins the collected texts with exactly one paragraph mark per paragraph.

scenarios.title: Split by Paragraphs splits a two-paragraph text box in real PowerPoint via the dialog driver
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Split by Paragraphs on one text box holding two non-empty paragraphs shows its confirmation dialog (the driver measures dialogSeen=True), the driver dismisses it with a synthetic key press (dialogClosed=True), the feature splits the box into exactly two text boxes carrying first paragraph and second paragraph (measured countBefore=1 countAfter=2 hasFirst=True hasSecond=True), returns true, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.
